what_happened: 历史 run-06 在两个未返回 toolCall 后留下 state=RUNNING、没有 output.txt、没有 exit_code；改前 guest-native-pi-agent.ps1 只在子进程正常退出后一次性写 output 和 finalize。
observed: EPT-PI-COMM-DIAG-20260929-01 Guest report and verify/t-hang status show partial output retained and PI_CHILD_TIMEOUT_OR_STALL
expected_behavior: A child that fails, hangs, or times out leaves readable partial stdout/stderr, byte counts, heartbeat and a terminal classification; normal exit remains COMPLETED.
impact: Host previously could not distinguish a live long task from a killed or hung runner and lost the only model output needed to classify the failure.
confirmed_cause: Output and status finalization were after WaitForExit; no bounded timeout, streaming drain or orphan-child cleanup existed.
minimal_change: stream stdout/stderr through asynchronous 8 KiB reads
create output files before child start
finalize status in finally, separate runner errors into stderr, and record runner_pid/heartbeat/partial_output
verification: verify/t-fail => FAILED with partial_output=true and separated stdout/stderr
verify/t-hang => FAILED/PI_CHILD_TIMEOUT_OR_STALL with partial output and no leaked test child
formal scripts parse with PowerShell Parser
remaining_risk: If the runner PowerShell process itself is forcibly killed, finally may not run; Host harvest now classifies stale heartbeat as RUNNER_DIED_STALE_HEARTBEAT.
